name: Lovedori Halation
original_name: らぶ撮りハレーション
source: Players take on the role of male student and member of the photography club, Ichinose Kaoru, aiming to win the photo contest at the cultural festival while honing their photography skills. They also enjoy romance and cosplay H (love photography H and role-playing H) with their cousin, older sister, busty teacher, tsundere class representative, and mischievous younger sister.
translation: 玩家扮演男学生、摄影社成员一之濑薰，目标是在文化节摄影比赛中获胜，同时磨练自己的摄影技巧。她们还和表弟、姐姐、巨乳老师、傲娇班代表、调皮妹妹一起享受浪漫和cosplayH（爱摄影H和角色扮演H）。
